title: Large int64 values (resource version) must be stored as strings in Bleve, not numbers
answers: Why is ResourceSearchRow.resource_version / the rv column always zero?
Search results return resource version 0 even though the document has a version
How do I store a large int64 (resource version) in a Bleve index field?
Folder children / label-selector list returns wrong or missing resourceVersion
body:
Symptom: search results always carried resource_version 0 / empty rv column; the label/field-selector list path read the latest version instead of the indexed one, and folder children returned no resourceVersion.
Root cause: Bleve stores all numbers as float64, which cannot represent an int64 resource version exactly (~1.9e18 > 2^53), so storing RV as a number silently rounds it to a wrong or empty value (pkg/storage/unified/resource/document.go:IndexableDocument).
Fix pattern: store the value as a decimal string in a dedicated internal field (RVString/_rv, set in UpdateCopyFields) instead of the numeric field, and parse it back to int64 on read (pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve_field_values.go:bleveIndex.hitResourceVersion), serving it via row.ResourceVersion rather than through the generic cell encoder (which rejects a string for an INT64 column) in pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go:bleveIndex.hitsToTable.
Constraints: use this string-then-parse pattern for any field whose value can exceed 2^53 and needs exact round-tripping through Bleve (deleted_rv already does this); on parse failure or absent field, treat the value as 0/unknown rather than erroring, since old indexes won't have the field until rebuilt.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/resource and pkg/storage/unified/search Bleve document mapping and search result builders

search: Large int64 resource versions (values approaching 1.9e18) must be stored as decimal strings in Bleve indexes, not numbers, because Bleve stores all numbers as float64 which loses precision for int64 > 2^53, resulting in empty or rounded resourceVersion in search results. The pattern (implemented in pkg/storage/unified/resource/document.go:IndexableDocument via UpdateCopyFields) stores the value in a dedicated _rv string field and parses it back in pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve_field_values.go during hitResourceVersion and bleveIndex.hitsToTable. On parse failure or missing field in old indexes, default to 0 rather than error; apply this string-then-parse pattern to any indexed field whose value can exceed 2^53.
